scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hey hey. I don't have time for chit-chat, I'm a pretty busy guy. There's all these Merchants working hard to become Blacksmiths.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嘿，嘿。我没时间闲聊，我可是个很忙的人。这里有很多商人正在努力成为铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Wait a minute, I think I've met you before.
Ummm.....
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
等等，我觉得我以前见过你。
嗯......

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you the one who broke my weapon and ran away? Or are you the one who tortured me so that I'd forge a weapon for you? Why can't I remember?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是那个弄坏我的武器然后逃跑的人吗？还是那个折磨我，逼我为你打造武器的人？我怎么想不起来了？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
.......
I can't remember who you are for the life of me. Is this deja vu?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
......
我完全想不起你是谁了。这是既视感吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Argh!! This is really bugging me! But still, I can sense that there's something special about you. Oh well, whatever. Have a good day~
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
啊！！这真让我心烦！不过，我感觉到你身上有些特别之处。算了，无所谓。祝你今天愉快~

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Welcome!
We are Workers of Steel,
the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
欢迎光临！
我们是钢铁工人，
铁匠公会。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
We pour the fervor
and passion of our souls into
our craft. Our skills of melting metal into new weapons
and tools is truly a form of art!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
我们将灵魂的热忱与激情
倾注于我们的技艺之中。
我们将金属熔炼成新的武器
和工具，这真是一种艺术！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You... look like a stranger. But somehow it seems that you're related to our guild. Haha~
Am I right?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你......看起来像个陌生人。但不知为何，感觉你与我们的公会有关。哈哈~
我猜对了吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh~
what a very
pretty lady!
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦~
多么漂亮的女士！
你对成为铁匠
感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you interested in
becoming a Blacksmith?
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你对成为铁匠
感兴趣吗？

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
First, you must become a Merchant before you can become a Blacksmith. Go to the city of Alberta to learn the Merchant trade.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
首先，你必须成为商人，然后才能成为铁匠。去艾尔贝塔学习商人的技艺吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh, are you interested in having a weapon forged? I'm sorry to disappoint you, but I actually have a lot of business to attend to.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦，你对打造武器感兴趣吗？很抱歉让你失望了，但我现在有很多公务要处理。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh...
There's not much we can offer you here. And you can't really help out around here unless you know how to make stuff...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦......
我们这里能提供的东西不多。而且，除非你知道如何制作东西，否则你在这里也帮不上什么忙......

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh? What's a magic user doing here? I'm surprised. Usually this kind of rough work is beneath you intellectual types.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦？一个魔法师来这里做什么？我很惊讶。通常这种粗活是不屑于你们这种知识分子做的。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Am I correct in assuming you're a member of the Clergy? Would you please bless me before you leave!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！我猜得没错的话，你是神职人员吧？在你离开之前，请为我祝福一下！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry...
But there really isn't anything for you to steal here. Well, there are the Daggers we keep in the back, but...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
很抱歉......
但这里真的没有什么可偷的。嗯，后面有一些短剑，但是......

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
So how's the pharmacy business going on recently?
Well, my forging business does not seem to grow any longer.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
最近你的药剂生意怎么样？
嗯，我的锻造生意似乎不再增长了。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Oh! Long time no see.
Have you come to purchase supplies from Christopher? These days I'm stuck behind this desk. My body's itching to strike the ol' anvil.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
哦！好久不见。
你是来向克里斯托弗购买物资的吗？这些天我一直被困在这张桌子后面。我的身体痒痒的，想敲打那把老铁砧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
在转职为铁匠之前，你必须先用完所有的技能点。请在明智地使用技能点后回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Why don't you stop struggling
to make zeny as a Merchant and
join the elite Blacksmith class?
If you're interested, fill out this application with your name
and Job Level.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
为什么不停止作为商人辛苦赚钱，
加入精英的铁匠职业呢？
如果你感兴趣，请填写这份申请表，
写上你的名字
和职业等级。

scripts.text: Fill out Application.
scripts.translation: 填写申请表

scripts.text: What are the requirements?
scripts.translation: 有什么要求？

scripts.text: Um, I need to think about it.
scripts.translation: 嗯，我需要再考虑一下。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You can't change to the Blacksmith Job Class without first using all your skill points. Please come back after wisely using your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
在转职为铁匠之前，你必须先用完所有的技能点。请在明智地使用技能点后回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Looks like you
meet the Job Level
Requirement.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
看来你符合
职业等级的要求。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You see, we don't accept just anybody into our guild. First, we only accept experienced Merchants with a true desire to become great Blacksmiths. Let's see...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你看，我们公会不是随便什么人都能加入的。首先，我们只接受那些有丰富经验，且真正渴望成为伟大铁匠的商人。让我看看……

scripts.text: ^3355FF*Shuffling of papers*^000000

[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
One of our Blacksmiths in Einbech, ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 has sent us word that he's short on help. Your first test of character will be to help him out.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
我们在艾音贝赫的一位铁匠，^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000，发来信件说人手不足。你的第一次品行测试就是去帮他一把。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Be careful
and good luck!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
小心点，祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm, it seems that you lack experience as a Merchant. We require that you are at least Job Level 40, you see.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯，看来你作为商人的经验还不够。你知道的，我们要求至少达到职业等级40。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I feel bad turning you away after you've come so far, but rules are rules. Sorry to disappoint you, but we'll welcome you back once you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你走了这么远的路，我很抱歉要拒绝你，但规定就是规定。很抱歉让你失望了，等你准备好了，我们随时欢迎你回来。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You want to know our requirements? First, you need to have Job Level 40 or higher as a Merchant. Second, you need to pass a test that will be given by the Blacksmith Guild.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你想知道我们的要求？首先，你需要作为商人达到职业等级40或更高。其次，你需要通过铁匠公会的测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
The test may consist of difficult tasks, but it's definitely not impossible. You will need to deliver certain items to different areas around the world
to complete the test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
测试可能包含一些困难的任务，但绝对不是不可能的。你需要将特定的物品送到世界各地不同的区域来完成测试。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hmmm...
Well, I hope
to see you again.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯……
希望下次能再见到你。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You haven't left yet?
Go to Einbech and find ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000. Finish helping him out, and when you're done, come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你还没走吗？
去艾音贝赫找^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000。帮他完成工作，结束后回来找我。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Was the work you did for ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000 to your liking? He's known for being pretty exacting...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你为^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000做的工作还满意吗？他可是出了名的挑剔……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Great job!!
You have passed
the first test...
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
干得漂亮！！
你通过了
第一次测试……

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Hm? You look surprised.
I guess you didn't know that there's more than one test. 
Haha, but don't worry, you are not going to travel that far.
Please go talk to the guildsman inside the building for more details about your next test.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
咦？你看起来很惊讶。
看来你不知道测试不止一个。
哈哈，不过别担心，你不需要跑那么远。
请去楼里找公会成员，了解下一次测试的详细信息。

scripts.text: I want to change my job quickly! But...oh well.
scripts.translation: 我想快点转职！但是……算了。

scripts.text: Grrr! Enough is enough!
scripts.translation: 嘎嘎！受够了！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
I'm sorry, but I'm sure you understand, right? We can't just casually accept anybody into
our guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
很抱歉，我相信你能理解，对吧？我们不能随便让任何人加入我们的公会！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
If we don't keep our standards,
we won't be able to maintain the respectability of the Blacksmith Guild!
We can't embarass our guild in this manner! *Ahem* Anyway, you talk to the guildsman inside the building now.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
如果我们不保持标准，就无法维护铁匠公会的声誉！
我们不能让公会蒙羞！*咳* 总之，你现在去楼里找公会成员谈谈吧。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Are you saying you're going
to quit the application process? That's an insult to our guild!
Get out of here! With that kind of attitude, you can forget becoming a member of the Blacksmith Guild!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你是说你要放弃申请流程？这是对公会的侮辱！
给我滚出去！就凭这种态度，你休想成为铁匠公会的成员！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You have no spirit!
If you can't endure this, you'll never be a Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你毫无斗志！
如果你连这点都坚持不了，就永远成不了铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Um? Haven't you talk to the guildsman yet?
If you haven't, I suggest you to do so as soon as possible.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
嗯？你还没找公会成员谈过吗？
如果没有的话，我建议你尽快去办。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
You are on a riding pet, so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
你正骑着宠物，无法转职。
请卸下坐骑后再试一次！

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Excellent, I can tell by the twinkle in your eye that you were successful. I can now bestow upon you the gift of the smithing, the art of the Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
太棒了，从你眼中的光芒可以看出你成功了。我现在可以授予你锻造的恩赐，也就是铁匠的艺术。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Always remember that we are creators, and artists over metals. Be wary that you do not fall into the pitfalls of selfishness
and greed.
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
永远记住，我们是创造者，是金属的艺术家。警惕自己不要陷入自私和贪婪的陷阱。

scripts.text:
[Altiregen]
Here is a little
gift to mark the
beginning of your
life as a Blacksmith.
Congratulations!!!
scripts.translation:
[阿尔蒂雷根]
这是一份小礼物，以纪念你铁匠生涯的开始。
恭喜！！！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hello there!
I'm ^8E6B23Geschupenschte^000000,
a Blacksmith by trade.
Nice to meet you!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你好！
我是^8E6B23格舒彭什特^000000，
以铁匠为业。
很高兴见到你！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Oh ho ho!
You're a Merchant!
Excellent! I was
in need of some help!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
哦呵呵！
你是商人！
太好了！我正好需要帮忙！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
But, of course,
I wouldn't bother you
if you're busy. Go along
your way if you must~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不过，当然，
如果你很忙，
我就不打扰你了。如果你必须走，那就去吧~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
After all...
I should know
how it's like
to be busy~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
毕竟...
我应该知道
忙碌是什么感觉~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Am I correct in assuming you are the help sent by the Blacksmith Guild? There aren't many trustyworthy people I can hire to help me, so I'm always
short on help.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我猜得没错的话，你就是铁匠公会派来的帮手吧？我很少能雇到值得信赖的人帮忙，所以总是人手不足。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm, in any case,
you are the help that was sent, right? Okay, I have some work for you that must be handled
right away!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯，不管怎样，
你就是被派来的帮手，对吧？好吧，我有一些工作必须马上处理！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Some time ago, I had a boy working for me who had no experience and bought the wrong supplies! It was terrible...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不久前，我雇了一个没有经验的男孩，结果他买错了材料！太糟糕了...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Anyone would hate to lose money through a foolish mistake like that. However, I have a slightly more difficult job for you.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
谁都会讨厌因为愚蠢的错误而损失金钱。不过，我有一项稍微困难一点的工作要交给你。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
However, I want to make sure that you have some basic knowledge as a Merchant. I'd like to ask you some questions, if that's okay.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
不过，我想确认一下你是否具备商人的基础知识。如果没问题的话，我想问你几个问题。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text: Um, can I have some time to prepare?
scripts.translation: 嗯，我可以花点时间准备一下吗？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
So, have you
studied a little
more this time?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
那么，
这次你
多学了一点吗？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I admit that it's pretty unreasonable to expect anyone to get a perfect score the first time around, so I'll give you
a little break...
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我承认，指望任何人第一次就拿到满分是不太合理的，所以我会给你一点宽限...

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You can miss
one problem!
Alright, let's start
with the questions~
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你可以错一题！
好了，让我们开始提问吧~

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
1. Which one of the following regions is matched incorrectly
with its specialty item?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
1. 以下哪个地区与其特产的对应是错误的？

scripts.text: Morocc - Thief Clothes
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇 - 盗贼之衣

scripts.text: Alberta - Two Hand Axe
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 双手斧

scripts.text: Comodo - Berserk Potion
scripts.translation: 克魔岛 - 菠色克药水

scripts.text: Alberta - Swordmace
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔 - 剑杖

[Geschupenschte]
2. What status can
be inflicted with the
^8E6B23Hammer Fall^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
2. ^8E6B23锤击^000000技能可以造成什么状态？

scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.text: Blind
scripts.translation: 致盲

scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text: Sleep

[Geschupenschte]
3. Which one of the following skills cannot be performed

scripts.translation:

3. 以下哪个技能是商人无法使用的？

scripts.text: Vending
scripts.translation: 露天商店

scripts.text: Discount
scripts.translation: 低价买进

scripts.text: Overcharge
scripts.translation: 高价卖出

scripts.text: Increase AGI
scripts.translation: 提升敏捷

[Geschupenschte]
4. Where can you find a store
that sells Blue Gemstones?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
4. 你可以在哪里找到出售蓝色魔力矿石的商店？

scripts.text: Alberta
scripts.translation: 艾尔贝塔

scripts.text: Morocc
scripts.translation: 莫洛奇

scripts.text: Geffen
scripts.translation: 吉芬

scripts.text: Prontera
scripts.translation: 普隆德拉

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
5. Where is the
Tool Dealer
located in Geffen?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
5. 吉芬的工具店位于哪里？

scripts.text: 8 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 从城镇广场看8点钟方向

scripts.text: 11 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 从城镇广场看11点钟方向

scripts.text: 6 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 从城镇广场看6点钟方向

scripts.text: 5 o'clock direction from the town square
scripts.translation: 从城镇广场看5点钟方向

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
6. Which weapon
cannot be used
by a Merchant?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
6. 商人无法使用哪种武器？

scripts.text: Stiletto
scripts.translation: 匕首

scripts.text: Ring Pommel Saber
scripts.translation: 圆柄马刀

scripts.text: Chain
scripts.translation: 锁链

scripts.text: Bible
scripts.translation: 圣经

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
7. Which one of the following
has the highest defense rate?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
7. 以下哪件装备的防御率最高？

scripts.text: Panties
scripts.translation: 内裤

scripts.text: Mink Coat
scripts.translation: 毛皮大衣

scripts.text: Wooden Mail
scripts.translation: 木制盔甲

scripts.text: Silk Robe
scripts.translation: 丝质外袍

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
8. For Level 3 weapons,
what is the ^8E6B23Safe^000000 limit
for upgrading?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
8. 对于3级武器，^8E6B23安全^000000强化上限是多少？

scripts.text: up to + 3
scripts.translation: 最高+3

scripts.text: up to + 4
scripts.translation: 最高+4

scripts.text: up to + 5
scripts.translation: 最高+5

scripts.text: up to + 6
scripts.translation: 最高+6

scripts.output:
[格舒彭什特]
9. 使用^8E6B23短裤^000000可以制作出什么物品？
scripts.text:
9. What item
can be made using
the ^8E6B23Trunks^000000 item?
Sakkat
scripts.translation: 草帽

scripts.text: Ghost Bandana
scripts.translation: 亡者发箍

scripts.text: Majestic Goat
scripts.translation: 宏伟的山羊

scripts.text: Antler

哦呵呵~
太好了！
你真是
一位出色的商人！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Good job!
Return to ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000 in Einbroch, the guy you first met when you applied for the Blacksmith job.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
干得好！
回到艾音布罗克的^8E6B23阿尔蒂雷根^000000那里，
就是你申请铁匠职业时第一次见到的人。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
I have faith that you
will be a great Blacksmith!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
我相信你
会成为一位出色的铁匠！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
You mean...
You didn't get
a receipt?
What...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
你的意思是...
你没有拿到
收据？
什么...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
A receipt is
a Merchant's best friend!
It's necessary to your job!
You'll have to start your
test all over again!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
收据是
商人最好的朋友！
它是你工作所必需的！
你得重新开始
你的测试了！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Return when you
find the receipt~
You didn't forget
to receive a receipt.
Right...?
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
找到收据后再回来~
你没有忘记
要收据吧。
对吧...？

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Thank you
very much
your help.
Return to Einbroch
and see ^8E6B23Altiregen^000000!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
非常感谢
你的帮助。
回到艾音布罗克
去找^8E6B23阿尔蒂雷根^000000吧！

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Hmm...?
You already finished
your test here with me!
And surprisingly, I don't
need any more help, today.
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
嗯...？
你已经在这里
完成了测试！
而且出乎意料的是，
我今天不需要更多帮助了。

scripts.text:
[Geschupenschte]
Being
a Blacksmith
is truly great!
Don't you think so?
Mwahahahahah!!
scripts.translation:
[格舒彭什特]
当一名铁匠
真是太棒了！
你不觉得吗？
哇哈哈哈哈哈！！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh, hello!
Have you come
to deliver my
Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦，你好！
你是来送我的
言灵魔杖的吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You sure this is what I ordered, right? I mean, if it's been used,
I don't want it.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你确定这就是我订的那把，对吧？我是说，如果是用过的，
我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is one of the items I use...
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我用的其中一件物品...

scripts.text: I'm sure! It's brand new!
scripts.translation: 我确定！是全新的！

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Well...
I guess I can
wait a little longer.
Please hurry with
my delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
好吧...
我想我可以
再等一会儿。
请快点
把我的货送来~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
You're
absolutely sure?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
你
完全确定吗？

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you so much for traveling all the way here. That Geschupenschte, please smack him for me when you meet him for being so late on this order...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
非常感谢你大老远跑来这里。那个格舒彭什特，见到他的时候请帮我揍他一顿，因为他这次订单迟到了...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Please wait
a second, let
me give you a receipt~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
请稍等
一下，让我
给你开张收据~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Here it is.
Thank you so much!
Oh, and good luck~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
给你。
非常感谢！
哦，祝你好运~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Thank you
so much for
the delivery~
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
非常感谢
你的送货~

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
Oh...
It's been a while
since I've been
to Alberta.
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
哦...
我好久没去
艾尔贝塔了。

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I ordered something
from there a while ago,
but I haven't received
my delivery...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我很久以前
在那里订了东西，
但我还没收到
我的货...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
I wonder...
Could the Blacksmith Guild
be undermanned? I can't think of any other reason for them to be late...
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我想知道...
难道铁匠公会
人手不足吗？我想不出其他让他们迟到的原因...

scripts.text:
[Baisulist]
When will I get
my special Arc Wand?
scripts.translation:
[拜苏利斯特]
我什么时候
能收到我的特制言灵魔杖？

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...!
It's here!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
...！
它来了！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
This is what I ordered, right?
I don't want any used or old Gladius that you might have!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这就是我订的那把，对吧？
我可不要你们可能有的任何用过的或旧的短剑！

scripts.text: Whoops, not that one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，不是那把。

scripts.text: I guarantee you it is new.
scripts.translation: 我保证它是新的。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Oooh...!
Hurry up
with my Gladius~
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
噢...！
快把我的短剑拿来~

scripts.text: - She seems to be upset. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来很生气。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Hah hah hah!
Finally! Now...
Let me have
a look!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
哈哈哈哈哈！
终于来了！那么...
让我看看！

scripts.text: - She looks very happy. -
scripts.translation: - 她看起来很高兴。 -

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Are you with the
Einbroch Blacksmith Guild?
Give this message to Geschupenschte!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
你是艾音布罗克铁匠公会的吗？
把这个消息交给格舒彭什特！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
'^660000You're late!
Do you know how long
I've been waiting?!^000000'
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
'^660000你迟到了！
你知道我等了多久吗？！^000000'

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
But, this is also
a masterfully crafted item.
Tell him I'm satisfied with the quality of the workmanship.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
不过，这也是一件工艺精湛的物品。
告诉他我对做工的质量很满意。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Here's the receipt.
I think you did
a good job.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
这是收据。
我觉得你做得不错。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Thanks for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
谢谢你的送货。

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
...
......

[Wickebine]
They're late.
They're late,
they're late,
they're late~!
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
他们迟到了。
他们迟到了，
他们迟到了，
他们迟到了~！

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
How long does it take for something to ship from Geschupenschte? Usually, the Geffen Blacksmith Guild is pretty prompt...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
从格舒彭什特那里发货需要多久？通常，吉芬铁匠公会都很守时...

scripts.text:
[Wickebine]
Ooohh...
This is very
upsetting...
scripts.translation:
[维克贝恩]
噢...
这让人很沮丧...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ohhhhhh~
Is it here?
Very nice.
Let me take a look.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
噢~~~~~
它来了？
很好。
让我看看。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
So you're sure this is the item
I ordered, right? I wouldn't want it if it's been used.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你确定这就是我订购的物品，对吧？如果它是用过的，我可不要。

scripts.text: Whoops, this one is used!
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这把是用过的！

scripts.text: It was just made, so it's new.
scripts.translation: 刚做好的，是新的。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Hmmmmm!
Please deliver
the right sword!
I've been waiting
long enough already...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
嗯嗯嗯！
请送正确的剑来！
我已经等得够久了...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
You double checked?
Alright then, I'll take it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
你确认过了？
好吧，我收下！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Oh ho...
This is good.
Much better than
what I expected.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
哦呵呵...
不错。
比我预期的要好得多。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
With this sword...
My special moves will be even more powerful! I may even be able to perfect my fast attacking techniques! I love it!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
有了这把剑...
我的特技会更加强力！我甚至能完美掌握我的快速攻击技巧！我太喜欢了！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Okay then.
Let me give
you a receipt.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
那么。
让我给你
一张收据。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Here is
your receipt.
Thank you for
your business!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
这是
你的收据。
感谢惠顾！

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Thank you
for the delivery.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
感谢
你的送货。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
...

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
...
......

[Krongast]
When will the sword
I ordered finally arrive?
I need to try my ultimate skill, ^2F4F4FFine Edge^000000 with it.
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
我订购的剑
到底什么时候才能到？
我需要用它来尝试我的终极技能，^2F4F4F利刃^000000。

scripts.text:
[Krongast]
Ahhhhhhh!
I need to
have that sword!
scripts.translation:
[克隆加斯特]
啊~~~~~！
我必须要
那把剑！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Oh~
Is it finally here?
The package I ordered?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
哦~
终于到了吗？
我订购的包裹？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Um, this is what I ordered, right? I don't want an Arbalest that's been used before.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
嗯，这就是我订购的东西，对吧？我不要之前用过的弩。

scripts.text: Whoops, this is a used one.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这把是用过的。

scripts.text: I'm sure it's new.
scripts.translation: 我确定是新的。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Hmmmm.
Please hurry
and bring the
correct item.
I've waited too
long already...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
嗯嗯。
请快点
送来正确的物品。
我已经等太
久了...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
So, you're sure?
Let me take a look...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
那么，你确定？
让我看看...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
*wheet whoo*
Very nice!!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
*哇哦*
太棒了！！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
This is truly a quality made custom item. I love how there is a case for an eye patch! I really reallly love this~
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
这真是一件做工精良的定制物品。我喜欢它有一个独眼龙眼罩的盒子！我真的非常非常喜欢这个~

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Thank you!
For something of this quality,
I can even sell it for a high price even after I've used it!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
谢谢！
对于这种品质的东西，
即使我用过了，也能卖出高价！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Here!
Please take
your receipt.
I really appreciate
your hard work.
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
给你！
请收下
你的收据。
非常感谢
你的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Really,
I can't say it
enough. This is
top quality work~!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
真的，
我说多少次都不够。
这是顶级的做工~！

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Eh...
When will my
order arrive?
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
呃...
我的订单
什么时候到？

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
A custom made Arbalest
with a quality case to hold your eye patches. Only one person can make something like that...
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
一把定制的弩，
还配有存放眼罩的精美盒子。
只有一个人能做出这样的东西...

scripts.text:
[Talpiz]
Ahhhhhh...
The waiting
is unbearable!
scripts.translation:
[塔尔皮兹]
啊啊啊...
等待
让人难以忍受！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Sweet God...
Have you sent
an angel...?
Is that the Ring Pommel Saber
I ordered? It's my only hope...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
天哪...
你是派天使
来了吗？
那是我订购的圆柄马刀吗？
这是我唯一的希望...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Huuuk*^000000 This is what I ordered, right? I needed one especially
made to stop this poison...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
^666666*呼...呼...*^000000 这就是我订的东西，对吧？我特意定制它来解这种毒...

scripts.text: Whoops, this is my own Ring Pommel Saber.
scripts.translation: 哎呀，这是我自己的圆柄马刀。

scripts.text: I'm sure this is the one.
scripts.translation: 我确信这就是那把。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
N-Nooo...
Hurry...!
I need that
sword for its
an...ti...d-dote!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
不...不...
快...！
我需要那把剑
来解...毒...剂！

scripts.text:
^3355FFIt looks like
he's slowly dying...!
You'd better hurry.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF他好像正在慢慢死去...！
你最好快点。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghklk*^000000
Give it...!
Pleeeease!

^3355FFBismarc stabs
himself, repeatedly,
with the Ring Pommel Saber
that has been imbued with
the power of Green Herbs.^000000
scripts.translation:
^3355FF俾斯麦用那把蕴含绿色药草力量的圆柄马刀，
一次又一次地刺向自己。^000000

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
*Gasp gasp*

[Bismarc]
Please...
Help me up.
The poison is
still coarsing
through my body...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
请...
扶我起来。
毒素
仍在我的身体里
肆虐...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
OwwwWWWW!!
IT'S BURNING!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
好痛啊！！
它在燃烧！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
*Gasp Gasp*
*Whew* Okay,
I can feel the
antidote working now.
Just what I needed.
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
*喘气 喘气*
*呼* 好了，
我能感觉到解毒剂
起作用了。
正是我需要的。

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Here is
your receipt.
T-take it...!
It's yours!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
这是
你的收据。
拿...拿着...！
它是你的！

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
Thank you.
You saved
my life...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
谢谢你。
你救了我的命...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
^666666*Ghyklk*^000000
^666666*Huk Hukk*^000000
When will my
o-order arrive...?

[Bismarc]
The poison in
my body... the pain...
excruciating... L-lord...
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
我体内的毒素... 疼痛...
难以忍受... 主啊...

scripts.text:
[Bismarc]
When is the
antidote gonna
get here?!
scripts.translation:
[俾斯麦]
解毒剂到底什么时候
才能到？！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Oh...so you're the one who wants to be a blacksmith?
Nice, heh heh.
As you've realized from your past tests, you won't be promoted from Merchant to Blacksmtih immediately.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
哦...原来你就是想成为铁匠的人啊？
不错嘛，呵呵。
正如你在之前的测试中意识到的那样，你无法直接从商人晋升为铁匠。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
How much do you truly understand about smithing? Are you ready for me to ask you some questions?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
你对锻造究竟了解多少？
准备好让我提问了吗？

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是

scripts.text: No, not yet~
scripts.translation: 不，还没准备好~

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Alright...
My test is simple.
I'll ask five questions.
If you miss too many,
you fail. And I won't
tell you what you missed.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
好的...
我的测试很简单。
我会问五个问题。
如果你答错太多，
你就不及格。而且我不会
告诉你哪里答错了。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
Please listen
and answer carefully...
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
请仔细听题
并认真作答...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. What ability
is required to learn
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
1. 学习^8E6B23低价买进^000000技能需要
什么能力？

scripts.text: Level 3 Push Cart
scripts.translation: 3级手推车

scripts.text: Item Appraisal
scripts.translation: 物品鉴定

scripts.text: Level 10 Mammonite
scripts.translation: 10级金钱攻击

scripts.text: Level 3 Enlarge Weight
scripts.translation: 3级增加负重

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
2. When you attack
with ^8E6B23Hammerfall^000000,
what status effect can
you inflict on enemies?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
2. 当你使用^8E6B23大地之击^000000攻击时，
你能对敌人施加
什么状态效果？

scripts.text: Stun
scripts.translation: 眩晕

scripts.text: Blindness
scripts.translation: 失明

scripts.text: Chaos
scripts.translation: 混沌

scripts.text: Silence
scripts.translation: 沉默

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
3. How much Zeny is spent
when attacking with the
mastered Mammonite skill?
(Level 10 Mammonite)
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
3. 使用精通的金钱攻击技能
攻击时会消耗多少Zeny？
(10级金钱攻击)

scripts.text: 900 Zeny
scripts.translation: 900 Zeny

scripts.text: 1000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 1000 Zeny

scripts.text: 2000 Zeny
scripts.translation: 2000 Zeny

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
4. What is the
discount rate when
the ^8E6B23Discount^000000
skill is mastered?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
4. 当^8E6B23低价买进^000000技能
精通时，折扣率是多少？

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
5. What is the maximum
percentage that you can
overcharge items sold to
NPCs after mastering the
^8E6B23Overcharge^000000 skill?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
5. 精通^8E6B23高价卖出^000000技能后，
卖给NPC的物品最高可以加价多少百分比？

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
1. Which of the
following monsters
drops Steel?
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
1. 以下哪种魔物
会掉落钢铁？

scripts.text: Zerom
scripts.translation: 杰洛米

scripts.text: Chon Chon
scripts.translation: 小羊

scripts.text: Skel Worker
scripts.translation: 骷髅工人

scripts.text: Requiem
scripts.translation: 诺可伊

[Mitehmaeeuh]
However, don't let your early success make you overconfident. A Blacksmith's life isn't a picnic. As proof that you have passed the test, I give you this Hammer of Blacksmith.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
不过，不要因为你早期的成功就过于自信。铁匠的生活并不轻松。作为你通过考试的证明，我授予你这把高级铁砧。

[Mitehmaeeuh]
Take this Hammer
of Blacksmith and go back to the Altiregen. Okay then? I wish you the best of luck!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
拿着这把高级铁砧，回到阿尔蒂雷根那里去。好吗？祝你好运！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
With your knowledge, or lack thereof, you'll just end up hurting yourself holding a hammer!

when you are ready...

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
I had to deal with the heat when I was in Morocc,
and now I have to deal with the smog in this Einbroch!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
我在莫洛奇的时候不得不忍受高温，
现在又得忍受艾音布罗克的烟雾！

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
But, I must admit that this is the perfect place for Blacksmiths because we have an abundance of crafting material supplies as well as highly developed equipment.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
但是，我必须承认，这里是铁匠的完美之地，因为我们拥有丰足的制造材料供应以及高度发达的设备。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We, Blacksmiths are trying our best to forge the best of the best weapons.
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
我们铁匠正在竭尽全力锻造最好的武器。

scripts.text:
[Mitehmaeeuh]
We pledge our honor on that!
scripts.translation:
[米特梅乌]
我们以荣誉担保！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Good day, are you here to visit Blacksmith Guild?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
你好，你是来参观铁匠公会的吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
I thank you for coming this far to visit our guild. However, I regret to inform you that Blacksmith Guild has been
moved to ^3131FF'Einbroch' in the Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
感谢您远道而来参观我们的公会。不过很遗憾地通知您，铁匠公会已经搬迁到了^3131FF修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的艾音布罗克^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
You can travel to Schwarzwald Republic by using the airship.
I can provide you a teleport service to Izlude, where you can use the airship.
Would you like to move to Izlude immediately?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
您可以乘坐飞空艇前往修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国。
我可以为您提供前往依斯鲁得岛的瞬间移动服务，那里可以乘坐飞空艇。
您想立即前往依斯鲁得岛吗？

scripts.text: How to go to Einbroch
scripts.translation: 如何前往艾音布罗克

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 准备好了！

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不用了，谢谢。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Oops, haven't you used the airship yet?
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
哎呀，您还没有使用过飞空艇吗？

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Unlike Rune-Midgarts Kingdom, Schwarzwald Republic has 'the airship' instead of teleport services to move between towns.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
与卢恩·米德加兹王国不同，修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国使用飞空艇在城镇之间移动，而不是瞬间移动服务。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
In ^3131FF'Izlude'^000000, you can use ^3131FF'the international airship'^000000 which travels between ^3131FFIzlude and Juno in Schwarzwald Republic^000000.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
在^3131FF依斯鲁得岛^000000，您可以乘坐往返于^3131FF依斯鲁得岛和修瓦鲁兹巴鲁德共和国的朱诺^000000之间的^3131FF国际飞空艇^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Take the airship, and go to Juno. Then from Juno, you need to take ^3131FFthe domestic airship^000000 to go to Einbroch.
Remember, you are ^3131FFnot going outside of the airport^000000 upon transit from the international to the domestic airship.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
乘坐飞空艇前往朱诺。然后从朱诺乘坐^3131FF国内飞空艇^000000前往艾音布罗克。
请记住，从国际飞空艇中转至国内飞空艇时，^3131FF不要走出机场^000000。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
It might sound complicated, but you will know once you are in the airport.
When you arrive in Blacksmith Guild, please send my regard to my coworkers!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
听起来可能有点复杂，但到了机场您就会明白了。
当您到达铁匠公会时，请代我向我的同事们问好！

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Excuse me, but you do not have enough money.
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
抱歉，您的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Blacksmith Guildsman]
Please take care!
scripts.translation:
[铁匠公会成员]
请多保重！
